4. The MMSE worsening signal suggests the population may be particularly vulnerable to adverse cognitive effects of D2/5HT2A modulation. No biomarker-defined subgroup analyses were reported.

However, the DLT criteria are not met per the structured rules — the dose was not truncated below target-engagement levels, and the trial was not terminated for safety. The primary failure mode is high placebo response compressing the treatment effect, with wrong population (dementia-related psychosis may not share the same dopaminergic mechanism as schizophrenia) as a secondary contributor.
